intro: Mozambique has huge gas reserves, coal and aluminium, but most people farm.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: The Mozal aluminium smelter, coal from Tete and gas offshore are big earners. Cashews, prawns and sugar are exported. The Cahora Bassa dam sells electricity to South Africa.

chapters.title: Poverty
text: Despite its resources, Mozambique is one of the poorest countries.

keyTerms.meaning: A factory that extracts metal from ore.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Mozambique makes and sells to the world.
